label: Fires strongly at D1 after an unrewarded visit to S1; tracks S1 belief later.
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 1) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * (prev_state == 1)
explanation: The raw candidate value of unit 4 is dominated by a large D1 jump (+0.8 to +0.9 over timing) when the previous trial reached S1 and was not rewarded, whichever action led there. At D1 a rewarded previous trial lowers it a little (about -0.15 to -0.2). At GO and D2 it scales with the ideal observer log-odds that S1 is good (higher when S1 is believed good). The free fit adds a carry-over of the S1-unrewarded boost into GO, a D2 bump when S1 is the state just reached, and a smaller dependence on the previous state at D2. No future variables are used. Timing (it rises over the episode) is in the baseline.

issues: The label leaves out the second term. At D1 after a rewarded trial the value is lower (weight -0.19). Dropping that term cuts test R^2 from 0.643 to 0.557, so it carries about 0.09 and a reader of the label cannot predict it.

'Tracks S1 belief later' is mostly a D2 effect. The belief-decile residual spans about ±0.15 at D2 and only about ±0.08 at GO. Belief at D2 alone scores 0.633; belief at GO alone scores 0.577; the two together (phase != D1) score 0.643.

One systematic error class remains. The S1-unrewarded rise carries over past D1: under-predicted by +0.27 at D2 after a1 S1 u, +0.19 at GO after a1 S1 u and +0.17 at GO after a2 S1 u. Adding (phase != D1)*(prev_state==1)*(prev_reward==0) as a 4th term raises test R^2 to 0.689. No 3-term form that includes it beats the recorded one: swapping it in for the D1-rewarded term gives 0.627.

Other remaining misses are moderate: over-predicted by -0.25 at GO after a1 S2 r and by -0.14 at D2 after a2 S2 u. The D1 jump is fit as a fixed offset, but the actual D1 value sits near +0.7 in the worst windows. Interacting it with episode decile, belief_lo, belief_cover or the reward two trials back adds at most 0.015.

The factual checks hold: a1 S1 u gives +0.87 and a2 S1 u gives +0.78, so the effect does not depend on the action taken. Using belief_lo beats raw belief (0.622) and beats state==1 at D2 (0.602). No future variables are used. The short form is 92% of the free fit (0.702) and 82% of the all-observed ceiling (0.78). None of the terms looks like curve fitting.
